data.one_liner: Unified API for on-device AI inference using native OS models.
data.what_it_does: Provides a unified API for on-device AI inference utilizing Apple Foundation Models, Android Gemini Nano, Windows AI APIs, and Chrome Prompt API. Supports text generation, streaming, structured JSON outputs, tool calling, and generative UI specs without bundled model checkpoints.
use_when: You need on-device AI inference using OS-managed models to save app size
You want native tool calling and structured schema outputs
You need generative UI capabilities driven locally
avoid_when: You require custom model checkpoints bundled directly with your app
You need full feature parity across all platforms including older OS versions
strengths: No app-bundled model checkpoints, reducing app download size
Leverages native OS-optimized AI capabilities and hardware acceleration
Unified API across iOS, Android, Windows, macOS, and Web
weaknesses: Platform support requires specific modern OS versions and hardware
Some features like tool calling or image inputs are platform-dependent and limited
data.setup_notes: Requires high minimum OS/hardware requirements (iOS/macOS 26+, Android API 26+, Windows 11 25H2 Copilot+ PC, Chrome 148+). Android requires specific Kotlin versions. Windows requires MSIX packaging and runtime configuration.

alternatives.name: firebase_ai
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer cloud-based Gemini models via Firebase instead of relying on device hardware constraints.

alternatives.name: tflite_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want to bundle custom TensorFlow Lite models directly within your app rather than depending on OS-managed models.

alternatives.name: llamadart
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want to run LLaMA models locally via native bindings instead of system-provided AI frameworks.
